question: Which Maratha ruler founded the Maratha Empire in 1674, proclaiming himself Chhatrapati?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shivaji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shivaji Bhonsle**, popularly known as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, founded the **Maratha Empire** in 1674.
 
• He was crowned as the **Chhatrapati** (monarch) at Raigad Fort in a grand coronation ceremony.
 
• Shivaji's reign marked the rise of the Marathas as a significant political power in India, challenging the **Mughal Empire**.
 
• He is renowned for his military strategies, administrative reforms, and promoting the Marathi language and culture.
 
• Shivaji's governance was based on a decentralized administration, ensuring welfare and justice for all his subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhatrapati Title:** The title "Chhatrapati" means "paramount sovereign" and was adopted by Shivaji during his coronation to signify his independent rule.
 
• **Raigad Fort:** Located in Maharashtra, Raigad Fort served as the capital of the Maratha Empire under Shivaji and was the site of his coronation.
 
• **Military Innovations:** Shivaji introduced guerrilla warfare tactics known as *Ganimi Kava*, which allowed his forces to outmaneuver larger armies.
 
• **Naval Power:** Shivaji established a robust navy to protect the Konkan coastline, making the Marathas a formidable maritime force.
 
• **Ashtapradhan Mandal:** Shivaji created an advisory council of eight ministers, called the "Ashtapradhan," to efficiently manage the empire’s affairs.
